Priya K: hey team — i'm starting on the feature-rollouts task this week. who should i ping for console/staging admin access so i can toggle feature flags and view canary rollouts? first week, so low perms right now :wave:
Sam D: hey @Priya K! welcome :wave: I can grant you temporary staging console admin. do you need prod access? if not, i'll give `console-admin-staging` role. also, check this guide: https://internal.redwood/console/feature-flags
Priya K: thanks Sam — just staging for now. what's the process? any approvals?
Sam D: no formal approval for staging. i'll provision a 72h temp role. after that, file the access-request form if you need extension. command I use:

```
# grant temp staging admin
rbac grant --user priya.k --role console-admin-staging --expires-in 72h
```

Sam D: once you have access you can toggle flags in Console > Feature Flags, or via API:
```
POST https://console.api.redwood/v1/flags/toggle
{
  "flag": "new-search-optimizer",
  "env": "staging",
  "state": "on"
}
```
Jon R (security): quick reminder: no prod flag flips without a change ticket + 2 people signoff :lock: Ping me if you think something needs prod rollout.
Priya K: got it, thanks! also, is there a staging project i should be attached to for metrics? want to check canary dashboards
Sam D: i'll add you to `staging-observability` project too. you should see dashboards at https://grafana.redwood/staging/dashboards
Infra-Bot: Access change recorded: user=priya.k action=grant role=console-admin-staging expires=176852... actor=sam.d
Alice M (people-ops): welcome to Redwood, Priya! if you need onboarding help or setup pairing, lmk :sparkles:
Priya K: appreciate it everyone — i'll try the toggle later and report back if anything blocks. cc @Sam D
Sam D: perfect. ping me in this thread when you're ready and i'll watch for any permission hiccups :thumbsup:
